title: Take control of your finances and pay your bills.
transcript: oftentimes there's resources on the bill itself. You know that if you can't pay this or you need help or whatever, call this number, go to this website and take it seriously because not everybody's going to meet a Steve who's going to, you know, help you get your financial life together. If anybody can take one thing away from my story, open the envelope. That was the thing I was so scared to do. And I remember the day that my husband sat me down with the stack of of bills that I had put in a corner. He's like, "We're just going to go through this. We're just going to see what's here." You know, and there really were resources on almost every bill.
